name: Celentano Pizzeria
kurzbeschreibung:
**Celentano Pizzeria in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian pizza in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Celentano Pizzeria**, we bring the flavors of Naples to **Innsbruck** and the surrounding region. Our wood-fired pizzas are crafted with passion, using only the finest ingredients—from fresh **San Marzano** tomatoes to slow-ripened mozzarella.

Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a creative **Quattro Formaggi**, every bite is a taste of Italy. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp Italian wine or a refreshing **Sanbitter**—the perfect way to unwind after a day exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes.

Visit us in **Innsbruck** at **Maria-Theresien-Straße 28** or enjoy our takeaway and delivery options. **Celentano Pizzeria**—where tradition meets **Tirol**’s charm!
